entry.author: Kordia
entry.summary:
The New Zealand media sector is at a crossroads. Declining traditional revenues and shifting audience behaviours are challenging local broadcasters to innovate faster than ever before.

In our premiere episode of Kordia Chats: In depth, Kordia’s Matt Patterson sits down with Arqiva’s Director of Global Media, Alaina Hall, to discuss how the new Kordia-Arqiva partnership is bringing global innovation to the NZ market.

In this 18-minute deep dive, they explore:

Hybrid Delivery Models: Why the future isn’t broadcast or streaming—it’s both.

Cloud-Enabled Playout: Moving away from rigid contracts to flexible, scalable solutions.

The "Experience" Mandate: Why maintaining broadcast-quality viewing is critical across all digital platforms.

Arqade & Streaming Optimisation: Real-world tools already helping NZ organisations deliver seamless global content.

Don't wait for the future to happen, be part of the conversation on how we’re future-proofing the NZ media ecosystem.

Learn more about our broadcast partnership and solutions: 👉 https://www.kordia.co.nz/broadcast/cloud-and-ott-solutions

#Broadcasting #Innovation #KordiaChats #MediaTech #NZBusiness
